operation.algorithm: output is the exact input JSON string, including empty strings and arbitrary length where source-valid

coverage.conditional_producer: A qualified rule is not an instance result; any missing applicability, identity or context prerequisite makes that destination BLOCKED and contributes no producer.

blockers.fingerprint_preimage: Exact entity_fingerprint canonical preimage and exclusion domain require qualified authority; historical hashes do not select it.
blockers.source_envelope_recipe: Source facts are governed, but this complete NM envelope field has no uniquely selected representation recipe.
blockers.completeness_recipe: Entity-specific completeness representation/criteria need an exact qualified recipe, not model-complete assertion.
blockers.custom_lifecycle: No accepted custom-entity lifecycle owner/value rule exists; existence_state is not lifecycle_stage.
blockers.declaring_context: Native standalone representation does not supply unique declaring ADR lifecycle provenance.
blockers.shared_identity: Coalesced shared system identity cannot activate competing producers; exact applicability must resolve first.
blockers.relationship_branch: Entity-named inherited placement does not by itself qualify the canonical-relationship output branch.
blockers.relationship_envelope: Complete relationship record/envelope or generated identifier recipe is not selected by forward authority.
blockers.nonselected_output: No qualified producer for this conditional destination under this type/source branch.
blockers.owner_local_context: Governed owner identity, topology key and multiplicity must be independently qualified; no independent root.
blockers.custom_qualification: Exact selected CEC registry/custom contract and properties must qualify; CEC closure is not registry selection.
